subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the figure which can be placed at the sign of question mark (?) from the given alternatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d578dfb5d5daa81177fa89a11b3a200b4cdebda0563ceee59a3865787279cf3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f022fdde475e04b972a747984387b04bacc69ce153b833eca94116eee4b9322.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Inner shaded and empty squares are shifting in anticlockwise direction.

Outer square align with big square shifts in corner to corner in clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bcaa4f756d61e35d191a0936520a250a0d3c8b16f8c8014ddac8a2309bcc7a18.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08b713a2fc82f9a2d0a0b634d253b2a80669d7fef650ca6cdad129b867805ca5.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
